name: OmniModel Studio - Enterprise Diagram & Workflow Modeler
description: Comprehensive diagramming suite supporting ERD, BPMN, UML, DFD, IDEF0, SIPOC, Flowchart, CEQA, Gantt, PERT with nested grouping, multi-page breadcrumbs, sticky notes, RBAC, offline sync, real-time collaboration, and JSON REST API.
